item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We hold a stark position: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We work for a ban on superintelligence because humanity’s future is not something anyone has the right to gamble away.

2. We cannot build superintelligence safely with anything like current techniques. Building it means human extinction. We need a ban—not voluntary promises from the companies racing to create it.

3. We want humanity to have a future. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, that future ends: everyone on Earth will die. We are working to stop that outcome. We need governments to ban superintelligence.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. That is the reason for our work, and we will not soften it into a warning about mere disruption. Human extinction means the loss of every person, every community, and every future generation. We refuse to treat that outcome as an acceptable price for technological progress. Our task is to help secure a ban on superintelligence before anyone builds it. We are working to make the stakes unmistakable and turn that understanding into policy. We want a future in which humanity survives and flourishes—not a race that ends with nobody left.
